subject: POC workshop scheduling — prompt inventory, guardrails & load-test planning
messages:
From: Patrick O'Leary <patrick@acme.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-02-28T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: POC kickoff + hands-on workshop — request to schedule

Hi Olga + team,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the stakeholders at Acme are keen to run a short POC and would like a hands-on working session to:
- review our prompt inventory and prioritize prompts for routing tests
- discuss guardrails/structured output expectations for downstream systems
- run light load tests to validate latency under our expected traffic profile

Ideally we'd do a 90–120 minute working session the week of Mar 1. Are you available:
- Tue Mar 2, 10:00–12:00 PT
- Wed Mar 3, 13:00–15:00 PT
- Thu Mar 4, 09:00–11:00 PT

Attendees from our side: me (Patrick), Sana Ahmed (Platform Engineer), and Alex (Product). We'll need an engineer from Redwood for the load-test portion.

Can you confirm availability and any prep we should complete (format for prompt inventory, any guardrail templates)?

Thanks,
Patrick O'Leary
Senior Product Manager
Acme Corp

-----Original Message-----
(Conference notes attached in meeting follow-up)
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Patrick O'Leary <patrick@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-02-28T10:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: POC kickoff + hands-on workshop — request to schedule

Hi Patrick — great to hear Acme is ready to kick the tires. We're available and can cover the agenda you outlined. Proposed plan:

Agenda (90–120m):
1) 10–15m: Introductions & success criteria
2) 30–40m: Prompt inventory review and prioritization (bring example prompts)
3) 20–30m: Guardrails & structured-output requirements (we'll share a template)
4) 20–30m: Load test plan and lightweight run (we'll need your test keys + a Redwood engineer)
5) 10m: Next steps and mutual action plan

For availability, we can do Tue Mar 2 at 10:00 PT. If that works for you we'll send a calendar invite and drop a shared Drive folder for the prompt inventory and templates.

Prep: please upload your prompt inventory (CSV or Google Sheet) and a few representative examples. We'll provide: prompt-inventory template, structured-output JSON schema, and a one-page guardrails checklist.

I'll loop in Aditya to confirm who can cover load testing.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Director, Solutions
Redwood Inference
[attachment: session-agenda.pdf (PDF)]
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Patrick O'Leary <patrick@acme.com>
Date: 2026-02-28T11:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: POC kickoff + hands-on workshop — request to schedule

Thanks Olga — quick heads up: I have a deployment window that conflicts with Tue Mar 2 10:00–11:30 PT. Can we shift to Wed Mar 3 13:00–15:00 PT instead? That slot works for the infra/engineer team and gives us time to stage a small load harness.

If Acme prefers Tue, I can try to rearrange but Wed is the safer bet to ensure an engineer is present for the load test.

On Fri, Feb 28, 2026 at 10:03 AM Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com> wrote:
> Hi Patrick — great to hear Acme is ready to kick the tires. We're available and can cover the agenda you outlined....

Aditya
Principal SRE
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Patrick O'Leary <patrick@acme.com>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-01T08:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: POC kickoff + hands-on workshop — request to schedule

Hi Patrick — thanks, Wed Mar 3 13:00–15:00 PT works for us. I've drafted the shared folder and attached initial artifacts:
- prompt-inventory_v1.csv (CSV) — basic mapping of prompt id, example, expected output, criticality
- structured-output-template_v2.json (JSON) — recommended schema for downstream systems
- guardrails_onepage.pdf (PDF) — short checklist for safety/PII handling and response filters

Attachments: prompt-inventory_v1.csv, structured-output-template_v2.json, session-agenda.pdf

Prep items for Acme: please add at least 10 high-priority prompts to the sheet and flag cases that require strict structured outputs (tables, JSON with typed fields, etc.). For the load test, Sana — can you share a minimal test harness or expected QPS and representative payload sizes? We'll use that to size the short spike.

I'll send an updated calendar invite for Wed 03 Mar 2026 13:00–15:00 PT and include the Zoom link + test plan.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
[attachment: prompt-inventory_v1.csv (CSV)]
[attachment: structured-output-template_v2.json (JSON)]
From: Patrick O'Leary <patrick@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: Sana Ahmed <sana.ahmed@acme.com>, Alex <alex@acme.com>
Date: 2026-03-01T16:44:00-08:00
Subject: Re: POC kickoff + hands-on workshop — request to schedule

Thanks Marissa — Wed Mar 3 13:00–15:00 PT confirmed on our side. I've added our attendees to the calendar invite.

Sana — for the load test, target a short spike of ~50 concurrent requests (QPS ~20) with typical prompt sizes of 250–350 tokens; we'll provide API keys in the shared Drive folder by EOD Monday.

We'll populate the prompt sheet with the top 12 prompts and flag five that need strict structured output. Also, please include the Zoom link and the test harness README in the Drive folder.

See you Wednesday — appreciate the quick coordination.

Best,
Patrick
Senior Product Manager
Acme Corp
